standard_prerequisites.name: A.s.-to-zero characterization (Lemma 4.2)
standard_prerequisites.statement: Delivered in context (source lines 243-252): W_k(v) converges almost surely to zero iff the expected squared norms converge to zero.
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: converts the expectation statement into the almost-sure totality claim (source line 316).

core_obligations: First assertion (divergence implies totality): density reduces to vectors in the union of the F_i, linearity reduces to an orthonormal basis vector v_n, Lemma 4.2 converts convergence to the expectation limit, and Corollary 4.5 gives the product formula; the product of (1 - r_j) tends to zero iff the series of r_j diverges.

Second assertion (convergence implies infinite-dimensional orthogonal complement): pick nonzero v_i in F_{i-1}^perp cap F_i along an infinite set of indices with n_i > n_{i-1}; Corollary 4.5 gives E(norm Phi v_i)^2 = norm(v_i)^2 s_i with s_i strictly increasing to 1; the split of the expectation over A_k(epsilon) and its complement bounds P(A_k(epsilon)) by (1 - s_i)/(1 - epsilon^2), so the union of the A_k(epsilon) is null and A (finite-dimensional G_E) is null.
proof_roadmap: Two named proof environments delivered in order: a density-plus-recursion reduction for the divergent case, then a measurable-event estimate for the convergent case.
difficulty_reason: 311-319和373-395以Grassmannian条件期望得到残余投影的乘积公式；发散支以dense union和乘积极限得全性，收敛支选择新正交方向并分割有限维complement事件，令残余期望趋1强迫其概率0。完整九步作者链只计该主定理，八个投影/可测/递推支撑不另拆计。
